column2: Hehe... You caught me.
Um... you see...
This is some chocolate I made myself... If you would like it, would you try some?
Pant... pant... pant... Please...
Please don't ever go off by yourself to get $$薬$$...
Promise me you won't, all right?
...*sniff*... Dummy, dummy...
I was so afraid... that you might not come back again...
Pant... pant... I-I can't breathe...
I-I'm sorry! My stomach hurts somehow...
Pant... pant... I-I feel sick...
I'm sorry... I made you worry!
Spring really is the season for fresh cabbage!!
Cut a cross into the top of the cabbage, tuck $$ベーコン$$ into it, then simmer it gently in consomme...
and you have the most delicious pot-au-feu!
Now that spring $$野菜$$ are in such abundance, I'm so happy!
Tomatoes and cucumbers are at their best right now, so...
wouldn't you like a salad piled high with summer $$野菜$$?
Lately I've been feeling worn out by the summer heat... Maybe I ought to eat something nourishing now and then...
Even if matsutake is out of reach... this year, I'd at least like shiitake rice...
In autumn, fish is so good that I always want a second helping of rice...
Daikon is tastiest in winter, isn't it? A piping-hot simmered daikon, with just a dash of soy sauce...
Sorry! That was a little unladylike of me, wasn't it?
It is cold today! When the chill sets in like this, I crave a fish hot pot scattered with plenty of grated daikon...
wouldn't you like fish $$鍋物$$ scattered with plenty of grated daikon?
Spring really is the season for fresh cabbage! It must be growing all over the field now!
When I went to the field yesterday, the tomatoes and cucumbers looked so delicious...
They ought to be ready to eat sometime this week!
Say, I went to the field today and... the potatoes...
No, never mind! It was nothing!!
Daikon is in season now! If you bring some back...
I'll make a delicious simmered dish for you!
What's wrong?! Is something hurting you?
All right, all right! Don't be spoiled... Work hard at your $$リハビリ$$.
Come on, get some rest now!
I don't think you should overdo it.
H-hey! Are you all right? Please don't overdo yourself...
If you hurt yourself, it won't do anyone any good...
Please... don't overdo it. All right?
Good work! I've drawn a bath for you.
Shall I... wash your back?
Wow, you worked hard today! I can't let myself fall behind.
